entities.summary: Serdar Üstüner is a boxer from Turkey. He boxed for the Turkey in the 2004 Summer Olympics where he was stopped in the first round of the Men's Middleweight (75 kg) division by Uzbekistan's Sherzod Abdurahmonov. He qualified for the Athens Games by ending up in second place at the 3rd AIBA European 2004 Olympic Qualifying Tournament in Gothenburg, Sweden. In the final he lost to Hungary's Károly Balzsay. Serdar Üstüner was a athletes & competitors from Istanbul (b. 1983-03-01, Istanbul). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
